stories.headline: Anthropic Launches Claude Computer Use on Mac, Letting AI Click and Navigate Your Desktop

key_facts.fact: Claude can now click, scroll, and navigate web pages and applications on Mac to complete tasks like opening files, browsing the web, and running dev tools
The feature is available as a research preview for Claude Pro and Max subscribers on macOS only
Claude uses a tiered approach: it first checks for direct integrations (Google Calendar, Slack), then falls back to computer control using the screen if no connector exists
Pairs with Dispatch, a mobile tool debuted last week that lets users assign tasks to Claude from their phone to be completed on their Mac
Safety features include a permission-first approach where Claude requests access before touching new applications, and users can stop Claude at any time
The feature competes directly with OpenClaw-like computer use capabilities from Perplexity, Meta's Manus, and others in the growing AI agent space

stories.headline: Google Launches Antigravity Coding Agent in AI Studio for Full-Stack App Building from Prompts

key_facts.fact: Google launched a full-stack 'vibe coding' experience in AI Studio powered by a new Antigravity coding agent that translates prompts into production-ready applications
The system automatically integrates Firebase, detecting when apps need databases or authentication and provisioning Cloud Firestore and Firebase Authentication
Supports Next.js alongside React and Angular, with persistent sessions that let users resume work across devices
The Antigravity agent understands entire project structures and chat history, enabling faster iteration and precise multi-step code edits
Includes a built-in secrets management system for securely storing API keys and credentials for external service connections

stories.headline: Meta Acqui-Hires Dreamer AI Agent Startup, Adding Ex-Stripe CTO to Superintelligence Labs

key_facts.fact: Meta acqui-hired the co-founders of agentic AI startup Dreamer, including CEO David Singleton (former Stripe CTO and Google Android VP), Hugo Barra (ex-Meta VR head), and CDO Nicholas Jitkoff (Chrome OS designer)
The team joins Meta's Superintelligence Labs under Chief AI Officer Alexandr Wang, working on AI agents and associated projects
Dreamer had raised $56 million at a $500 million valuation in November 2024; Wang was an angel investor in that round
Dreamer remains a standalone legal entity; Meta receives a non-exclusive license to its technology; investors will be paid more than their original investment
CEO Singleton demonstrated the technology to Mark Zuckerberg earlier in 2026 before the deal

stories.headline: Cisco Launches LLM Security Leaderboard; Anthropic Claims 8 of Top 10 Spots

key_facts.fact: Cisco launched its LLM Security Leaderboard at RSAC 2026, ranking models by resistance to adversarial attacks including single-turn and multi-turn jailbreak attempts
Anthropic dominated with 8 of the top 10 spots: Claude Opus 4.5 at #1, Sonnet 4.5 at #2, and Haiku 4.5 at #3
OpenAI's GPT-5.2 placed 7th and GPT 5 Nano 9th; Mistral models occupied the bottom positions alongside DeepSeek, Cohere, Qwen, and xAI
The leaderboard evaluates multi-turn conversational attacks that better reflect real-world adversarial behavior where attackers degrade guardrails over longer conversations
Cisco's AI Readiness Index found 83% of organizations plan to deploy agentic AI, but only 29% felt ready to do so securely

stories.headline: Google Deploys Gemini Agents to Crawl Dark Web, Processing 10M+ Events Daily at 98% Accuracy

key_facts.fact: Google launched a dark web intelligence service in Google Threat Intelligence using Gemini agents that process 8-10 million dark web events daily in public preview
Internal tests show 98% accuracy in analyzing millions of daily external events, covering initial access broker activity, data leaks, and insider threats
Traditional dark-web monitoring tools use regex-based keyword scraping; the Gemini-powered system uses AI to distill relevant threats from the noise
Announced at RSAC 2026 alongside Google's completed Wiz acquisition integration and broader agentic SOC strategy powered by Gemini models
Part of a broader 'agentic security operations center' strategy introducing adaptive AI agents that can investigate alerts, synthesize data, and respond at machine speed

stories.headline: RSAC 2026: CrowdStrike, Palo Alto, Cisco Launch AI Agent Security Platforms in Coordinated Push

key_facts.fact: CrowdStrike expanded Falcon to discover shadow AI agents, MCP servers, and LLM runtimes across endpoints, SaaS, and cloud, treating the endpoint as the control plane for AI security
CrowdStrike's AIDR monitors prompts, data interactions and runtime behavior in AI products including ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, DeepSeek, Copilot, and Cursor
Palo Alto Networks launched Prisma AIRS 3.0 to secure the entire agentic AI lifecycle from observing interactions to safely authorizing autonomous execution
Cisco released DefenseClaw, an open-source secure agent framework that automates security and inventory, with plans to integrate with NVIDIA OpenShell as sandbox
Cisco extended Zero Trust access to AI agents via Duo IAM with MCP policy enforcement, enabling fine-grained permissions limiting agent tool access to specific resources and timeframes

stories.headline: Interloom Raises $16.5M to Capture 'Tacit Knowledge' for Enterprise AI Agents

key_facts.fact: Munich-based Interloom raised $16.5 million in a seed round led by DN Capital, with participation from Bek Ventures and Air Street Capital
The company builds a 'context graph' by ingesting operational records like support emails, service tickets, and call transcripts to map how problems actually get resolved in organizations
Commerzbank deployed it to analyze millions of customer support emails, reducing the gap between documented and actual operational knowledge from ~50% to 5%
Customers include Volkswagen and Zurich Insurance, which named Interloom winner of a company-wide AI competition beating ~2,000 competitors for underwriting use cases
Founded by Fabian Jakobi, serial entrepreneur who previously sold Boxplot to Hyperscience in 2021; the company is developing a 'Chief of Staff' product layer for managing AI agent performance

stories.headline: Oracle Launches 22 Fusion Agentic Applications with Coordinated AI Agent Teams at AI World

key_facts.fact: Oracle announced Fusion Agentic Applications, a new class of 22 enterprise apps powered by coordinated teams of specialized AI agents that are outcome-driven and reasoning-based
Built into Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications, the agents can make and execute decisions within business processes by accessing unified enterprise data, workflows, and approval hierarchies
Applications span workforce operations, design-to-source workspace, cross-sell programs, and collectors workspace for cash collection
Analyst Holger Mueller of Constellation Research said Oracle has moved ahead of ERP rivals including market-share leader SAP with this agentic approach
Announced at Oracle AI World in London on March 24, alongside updates to Oracle AI Agent Studio with a new Agentic Applications Builder

stories.headline: SoftBank to Build 10GW AI Datacenter on Former US Nuclear Weapons Site in Ohio

key_facts.fact: SoftBank's SB Energy is redeveloping Department of Energy land at the former Portsmouth Gaseous Diffusion Plant in Piketon, Ohio for a massive AI datacenter campus called 'PORTS Technology Campus'
The project includes a 10GW server farm, 10GW of new power generation capacity (minimum 9.2GW gas-fired), and a $4.2 billion grid upgrade across Southern Ohio by American Electric Power
Consortium includes Hitachi, Mitsubishi Electric, Toshiba, TDK, Sumitomo Mitsui Banking, Bechtel, Morgan Stanley, Goldman Sachs, and J.P. Morgan
Power expected to reach the site by 2029; SB Energy commits to funding accelerated cleanup of uranium contamination
Energy Secretary Chris Wright stated the investment 'supports the AI boom and cutting-edge technologies while strengthening our energy system and helping keep costs down for the American people'

stories.headline: Nvidia and Emerald AI Unveil Flexible AI Data Centers with Six Major Utilities, Claiming 100GW Potential

key_facts.fact: Nvidia and grid software company Emerald AI announced a coalition with six major energy companies — AES, Constellation, Invenergy, NextEra Energy, Nscale Energy & Power, and Vistra — to build AI data centers that dynamically respond to grid conditions

The system pairs Nvidia's DSX Flex software (allowing data centers to draw on co-located generation and battery storage before full grid connection) with Emerald AI's Conductor platform (coordinating electricity usage alongside onsite generators and batteries)

Jensen Huang described the effort as 'Energy, compute, networking and cooling as one architecture'; Emerald AI CEO Varun Sivaram said 'AI factories are too valuable to be treated as either passive loads or permanent islands'
Early demonstrations completed across five commercial data centers; commercial deployment targeted for later in 2026 at Nvidia AI Factory Research Center in Virginia

stories.headline: Google Warns US Power Grid Can't Keep Up with AI Data Center Demand at CERAWeek

key_facts.fact: Alphabet/Google President Ruth Porat stated 'We are concerned that we are not full throttle on energy' at CERAWeek in Houston on March 23, flagging power as an obstacle on par with semiconductors for AI

US electricity demand rose 1.7% annually since 2020 after a decade of flat usage; projected to increase 1.9% in 2026 and 2.5% in 2027, with data centers expected to reach 9% of US demand by 2030 (up from 4% in 2025)
Google has made available up to 1 gigawatt of demand-response capacity, equivalent to powering approximately 750,000 homes
Energy stocks surged on the day: Constellation Energy +$7.68, Vistra Energy +$5.73, Talen Energy +$13.09

stories.headline: TSMC's 2nm Capacity Crunch May Force Nvidia to Redesign Next-Gen Feynman AI Chip Platform

key_facts.fact: TSMC is completely booked on its advanced 2nm production capacity through at least 2028, with explosive demand for AI and HPC straining cutting-edge nodes including the A16 variant with backside power delivery
Nvidia may be forced to redesign its next-generation Feynman AI chip platform, the successor to Vera Rubin architectures unveiled at GTC 2026, due to limited TSMC manufacturing capacity

Big AI companies like Nvidia and Meta are fighting for access to the same cutting-edge production lines, making AI chip supply tighter across the board; even TSMC's Arizona facility (not fully operational until 2030) is already fully reserved
TSMC's A16 variant offers 8-10% speed gains over prior nodes through backside power delivery technology

stories.headline: US Army Receives First Autonomous-Ready Black Hawk Helicopter, the H-60Mx

key_facts.fact: The US Army officially received its first H-60Mx Black Hawk helicopter on March 23, 2026 — a modified Black Hawk capable of flying with or without a pilot
Uses Sikorsky's MATRIX autonomy software suite, derived from DARPA's decade-long Aircrew Labor In-Cockpit Automation System (ALIAS) program
The Army Combat Capabilities Development Command (DEVCOM) will conduct rigorous testing to validate seamless transitions between manned, optionally piloted, and fully autonomous modes
The H-60Mx serves as the primary testbed for the Strategic Autonomy Flight Enabler (SAFE) program, which seeks to develop a universal autonomy kit deployable across the entire Black Hawk fleet
Sikorsky's Rich Benton noted: 'This capability will enhance mission effectiveness and survivability for warfighters today and lay the groundwork for tomorrow's networked systems'

stories.headline: US Army Places $52M+ Order for 2,500 Skydio X10D Drones, Largest Single-Vendor Tactical sUAS Order in Army History

key_facts.fact: The US Army ordered over 2,500 Skydio X10D drones for $52+ million — the largest small unmanned aircraft system (sUAS) procurement from a single manufacturer in Army history
The order moved from bid to award in less than 72 hours, reflecting urgency in military drone procurement
Skydio described itself as 'the largest U.S. drone manufacturer and world leader in flying robots'; the order reflects 'the decisive role small autonomous systems now play in modern conflict'

stories.headline: GM Begins Supervised Autonomous Testing on Public Roads in California and Michigan

key_facts.fact: GM announced it will start supervised public-road testing of autonomous driving technology on limited-access highways across California and Michigan, with the goal of reaching 200 vehicles this year
Each vehicle will operate with a trained test driver at the wheel capable of taking manual control at any time, marking a transition from manual data collection to active automated technology testing
GM has said it will launch its first hands-free, eyes-off Level 3 driving feature in the Cadillac Escalade IQ in 2028

stories.headline: Enigma Aerospace Emerges from Stealth with Autonomous Cargo Drone for Contested Military Logistics

key_facts.fact: Enigma Aerospace, a defense technology company based in Burlington, Massachusetts, emerged from stealth with $7M in aggregate venture and Department of War funding from investors including Cybernetix Ventures, Valia Ventures, and the U.S. Air Force

The Phoenix aircraft is an autonomous, ultra long-range cargo drone with up to 1,000 lb payload capacity, exceeding 2,000 nautical miles range, capable of precision airdrop or short takeoff/landing in GPS-denied environments
CEO Reese Mozer's core thesis: 'Logistics — not firepower — is the limiting factor in modern warfare'; the company targets deployment by 2027

Team includes veterans from American Robotics, Ondas, Carnegie Mellon, Stanford, and the U.S. Air Force; advisors include Gen. (ret) Mike Minihan (USAF Air Mobility Command) and Gen. (fmr) Charles Hamilton (USA Army Materiel Command)

stories.headline: Netherlands Becomes First NATO Nation to Embed Drone and Counter-Drone Units in Every Army Combat Formation

key_facts.fact: The Netherlands will begin recruiting 1,000-1,200 military personnel starting in April to staff newly created drone and counter-drone units embedded across every combat formation in the Royal Netherlands Army

Commander of the Armed Forces General Onno Eichelsheim announced the initiative on Dutch TV program WNL Op Zondag, stating 'It is a different interaction. We must continuously modernize and adapt systems'
This is a structural overhaul — not a pilot program or task force — making the Dutch army the most drone-integrated ground force in NATO, with no other ally having gone this far or this fast

stories.headline: Reuters Reveals Netanyahu-Trump Call That Led to Joint Strike Killing Khamenei

key_facts.fact: Netanyahu called Trump less than 48 hours before the Feb 28 US-Israeli strike on Iran, arguing there might 'never be a better chance to kill Khamenei'
New intelligence showed Khamenei's meeting with key lieutenants at his Tehran compound had been moved forward from Saturday night to Saturday morning, creating a closing window
Trump had already approved the concept of US military action against Iran but had not yet decided when or under what circumstances to get involved
Netanyahu argued Trump could 'make history' by eliminating Iranian leadership and potentially triggering an uprising to overthrow the theocratic system
Netanyahu also cited Iran's murder-for-hire plot allegedly orchestrated against Trump in 2024 when he was a candidate

stories.headline: Trump Claims 'Major Points of Agreement' With Iran on Ending War; Tehran Denies Talks

key_facts.fact: Trump posted that US and Iran had 'VERY GOOD AND PRODUCTIVE CONVERSATIONS REGARDING A COMPLETE AND TOTAL RESOLUTION OF OUR HOSTILITIES' and ordered a 5-day halt on strikes against Iranian energy infrastructure
Trump told reporters 'We have major points of agreement' and said Iran agreed to never have a nuclear weapon: 'That's number one, two and three'
Iran's Foreign Ministry flatly denied talks, stating 'There is no dialogue between Tehran and Washington'
Iran's Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf called reports of talks 'fake news' intended to 'manipulate financial and oil markets'
Iran's Foreign Ministry confirmed receiving messages from friendly regional countries relaying US demands for talks

stories.headline: Israel Launches 'Unprecedented' Wide-Scale Strikes on Tehran as US Pauses Energy Attacks

key_facts.fact: IDF launched a new 'wide-scale wave of strikes targeting infrastructure of the Iranian terror regime across Tehran' about 40 minutes after Trump announced the 5-day pause
Al Jazeera's Tehran correspondent said the explosions were 'unprecedented' in size and volume, especially on eastern Tehran
The war has killed more than 2,000 people, shaken the global economy, sent oil prices surging and endangered some of the world's busiest air corridors
IDF told The Guardian that energy infrastructure would be spared, suggesting Israel may follow US in suspending targeting of Iranian power plants
US and Israeli forces have hit military installations as well as hospitals, schools and more than 5,000 residential units, according to analyst

stories.headline: Bahrain Proposes UN Resolution Authorizing 'All Necessary Means' to Protect Hormuz Shipping

key_facts.fact: Bahrain circulated a draft UN Security Council resolution authorizing countries to use 'all necessary means' including within territorial waters of littoral states to secure transit passage in the Strait of Hormuz
The draft resolution calls Iran's actions a threat to international peace and security and demands Iran immediately cease all attacks against merchant vessels
The draft is backed by other Gulf Arab states and the US, but diplomats say it is unlikely to succeed

Only a trickle of cargo ships and tankers, mostly Iranian, have made it through the Strait since Iran effectively blocked it three weeks ago; normally about 1/5 of global crude oil and LNG passes through
The resolution also expresses readiness to impose targeted sanctions on Iran

stories.headline: Zelenskyy Says Ukraine Has 'Irrefutable' Evidence Russia Sharing Intelligence With Iran

key_facts.fact: Ukraine's military intelligence has 'irrefutable' evidence that Russia continues to provide intelligence to Iran using signals intelligence and electronic intelligence capabilities
Zelenskyy said Russia is 'effectively prolonging the war' by helping Iran 'survive and strike more accurately'
Zelenskyy warned markets are 'already reacting negatively' and the situation is 'significantly complicating the fuel situation in many countries'
The Kremlin last week dismissed a Wall Street Journal report that Russia was sharing satellite imagery and improved drone technology with Iran as 'fake news'

stories.headline: Ukraine's Commander Says Russian Spring Offensive Failed After 619 Assaults in Four Days

key_facts.fact: Ukraine's Commander-in-Chief Oleksandr Syrskyi reported that Russia launched 619 assaults between March 17-20 but Ukraine stopped the advance
Ukrainian officials and unofficial sources described bloody Russian tank and infantry 'meat assaults' being cut apart by prepared defenses
The offensive targeted Ukraine's 'Fortress Belt' in Donetsk Oblast, anchoring key cities including Slovyansk and Kramatorsk

stories.headline: Oil Drops 11% on Trump's Iran Negotiation Claims; Goldman Sachs Raises Price Forecasts

key_facts.fact: Brent crude fell close to 11% to $99.94 per barrel after topping $112 on Friday; WTI dropped more than 10% to $88.13
Goldman Sachs raised its oil price forecasts, expecting Brent to average $110 in March and April, up from a previous forecast of $98 — a 62% jump from 2025 average
Bloomberg reported one of the largest intraday swings on record, with Brent dropping as much as 14% to near $96/bbl before partially recovering
Asian markets were hammered: Kospi fell 6.5% and Nikkei 225 dropped 3.5%, directly linked to escalating oil prices
IEA warned the crisis could rival the 1970s oil shocks, with Brent-WTI spread widening to $14/bbl reflecting geopolitical supply risk premium

stories.headline: Celosia Therapeutics Doses First ALS Patient in Gene Therapy Targeting TDP-43 Protein

key_facts.fact: Celosia dosed the first participant in its Phase 1b KOANEWA trial evaluating CTx1000, an investigational genetic medicine targeting pathological TDP-43 protein in ALS patients
CTx1000 is designed to selectively bind and clear toxic forms of TDP-43; in preclinical models it halted disease progression and in some cases partially reversed disease manifestations
The trial is conducted at Macquarie University Hospital in Sydney, Australia, registered as NCT07401121
Chief Medical Officer Prof Lars Ittner said the therapy 'for the first time, directly targets a fundamental disease mechanism in ALS'
The underlying discovery was published in Neuron in February 2024 by Professors Lars Ittner and Yazi Ke, then exclusively licensed to Celosia

stories.headline: Fauna Bio Hits Target Milestone in Eli Lilly Obesity Collaboration Using Hibernation Biology

key_facts.fact: Fauna Bio announced designation of a target under its strategic obesity discovery collaboration with Eli Lilly, a partnership that began in December 2023
The target was identified using Fauna Bio's Convergence AI platform and described as a potential first-in-class approach to treating obesity leveraging biology from hibernating mammals
The Convergence AI platform analyzes genomic data from more than 450 mammal species including hibernating mammals to identify novel drug targets
The milestone triggers a payment to Fauna Bio under the terms of the collaboration agreement
